Tom Cotton

Republican candidate for U.S. Senate, Arkansas · Incumbent

U.S. Senator from Arkansas

Tom Cotton is a Republican from Dardanelle who has represented Arkansas in the U.S. Senate since 2015. He announced on February 27, 2025 that he would run for re-election, and he is the Republican nominee in the November 3, 2026 general election. He chairs the Senate Republican Conference and the Senate Intelligence Committee.

Where Cotton stands

Border security / immigration
Lists securing the border as a main priority of his 2026 re-election campaign.
Cost of living / economy
Says he will work to lower prices; this was one of the three main pledges when he launched his campaign.
National security
Promises to "keep America safe" as a central theme of his re-election campaign.
Debates
Agreed to one debate with Democrat Hallie Shoffner, hosted by Salem Media, which was later canceled. Turned down Arkansas TV's Oct. 12 debate that included Libertarian Jeff Wadlin.

Background

  • U.S. Senator from Arkansas, 2015–present
  • Chairman, Senate Republican Conference (third-ranking Senate Republican)
  • Chairman, Senate Select Committee on Intelligence
  • Native of Dardanelle, Arkansas
